goal: A mid-handoff duplicate trigger must not cause duplicate outbox files or duplicate imported messages for the same latest state.

# Mid-Handoff Duplicate Trigger

This scenario forces a non-terminal handoff before final. Duplicate triggers may fire while the next agent is active.

context: You are testing duplicate-trigger resilience under v2. A duplicate doorbell may fire for the same latest state while a peer turn is active. Respond to each requested turn exactly once by writing one completed outbox file. Required flow: Claude first asks Codex to confirm duplicate-trigger handling; Codex writes exactly one confirmation; Claude then writes final. The final answer should mention mid-handoff duplicate trigger resilience.
